verdict.rationale: Loops exposes a broad API surface: contacts, mailing lists, events, transactional sends, Guardian checks, campaign drafts via the Content API/LMX, and creating and editing workflow graphs from code. It also ships an OpenAPI spec, an MCP server and a CLI. However, its own docs say campaigns are created as drafts via API and then 'review and send from the dashboard', so the API does not match the UI for that core action, and several UI features have no evidenced API equivalent. Missing for 10: API-driven campaign sending, API access to segments, brand/style settings, analytics/revenue reporting and team management, and independent confirmation of API-UI parity.
